description: Source code implementing the NetworkIsolationKey class, which manages network isolation parameters such as site information, cross-site flags, and nonces, with methods for serialization, debugging, and state checks.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Manages network isolation parameters including site information, cross-site status, and nonces, with methods for creation, serialization, and state inspection.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (non-persistent) NetworkIsolationKey with opaque site.

methods.name: CreateWithNewFrameSite
methods.description: Generates a new NetworkIsolationKey with the same top frame site and a specified new frame site.

methods.name: ToCacheKeyString
methods.description: Serializes the NetworkIsolationKey into a string suitable for cache keys, or returns nullopt if transient.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the state of the NetworkIsolationKey.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if all necessary site information is set.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Determines if the key is transient (not fully populated or opaque).

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode of network isolation keying based on feature flags.

methods.name: GetFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the frame site if mode is kFrameSiteEnabled.

methods.name: GetIsCrossSite
methods.description: Returns whether the key is cross-site if mode is kCrossSiteFlagEnabled.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both top and frame sites are unset.

methods.name: IsOpaque
methods.description: Checks if the key is opaque due to opaque sites or nonce.
